ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 17
   C. 31
   D. 27

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 22

5. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 2, 4, 6

6. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

7. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

8. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 65
   C. 16
   D. 64

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 24
   D. 156

11. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — 81
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 9² = 9 × 9
3. 9² = 81
Final Answer: 81
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. A — 25
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 7² + 24²
3. c² = 49 + 576
4. c² = 625
5. c = 25
Final Answer: 25 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
